scripts.start:deploy: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network localhost
scripts.start:backend: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && cd backend && node src/server.js
scripts.start:ai: cd ai-engine && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn risk_api:app --port 8000
scripts.start:frontend: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8545 && cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.start:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "Node,Deploy,Backend,AI,React" -c "cyan,green,yellow,magenta,blue" "npm run start:node" "npm run start:deploy" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:ai" "npm run start:frontend"
